tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: pale maple by day, dark walnut by night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and the result area of a Tool.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells behind inputs and table stripes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only; never the only sign of a control's edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; at least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and tape-soft (at least 12:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units and hints, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (at least 5.5:1).

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: The accent, the yellow of a tape-measure blade: primary action fill, selected state and the brand. Never text on the light surfaces (1.6:1); put on-tape text on it.

tokens.name: on-tape
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tape fill, such as the primary button's label (at least 8.8:1).

tokens.name: tape-ink
tokens.usage: The accent as text: links and highlighted values, on any surface and on tape-soft (at least 5:1).

tokens.name: tape-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: the highlighted result, the selected Strategy, the active navigation item.

tokens.name: walnut
tokens.usage: Brand wood tone for illustration, Stock bars in a Cutting Plan and the cover. Not for text in dark theme (3.5:1).

tokens.name: maple
tokens.usage: Light wood tone: Parts drawn on Stock, illustration fills. Ink text on it holds 7:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Validation errors and Unplaced Parts, as text or icon on any surface and on danger-soft (at least 5:1). Always paired with words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind an error message or an Unplaced Part row.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset, so it always lands on the ground (at least 9:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links: an alias of tape-ink.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Barlow: plain, slightly industrial, like workshop signage. Served from Google Fonts for now; self-host the woff2 files in the app.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page h1 of a Tool. One per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Add every Part you need, then choose a Strategy.
styles.usage: Running text. Never smaller on mobile.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints and helper text under a field, in ink-muted.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono: every digit the same width, a slashed zero, and 1, l and I that never get confused. Use it for every measurement a woodworker reads or types.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: The main result of a Tool, readable at arm's length.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Numbers inside inputs, tables and Cut Lists.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a value and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to input; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile; card padding; button inner padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between fields of a form; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, Stock bars: crisp like machined steel.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the result panel.

size.note: Target sizes for gloved or dusty hands.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs: larger than WCAG's 24px minimum, for use in the workshop.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Width of the focus outline, drawn in focus with a 2px offset.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a Tool's content column.
